accepted_causal_chain: Rerun138 used the intended rebuilt binary, deterministic reprovisioning, exact current PID/epoch/session/profile identity, exact five-member party, and MaxActiveCohorts=1.
The canary completed all 14 strict route terminals and confirmed real deaths for Corborus, Slabhide, Ozruk, and High Priestess Azil with no teacher or forbidden completion assistance.
Feral provisioning was corrected before launch: spell 77761 exists in both canonical catalogs, generated provisioning SQL, and exactly one verified live Feraltank character_spell row.

Canonical trace reconstruction still found zero feral_stampeding_roar_healer_threat_reposition actions and zero spell-77761 combat submissions while the specialized Feral handoff machinery remained active.

The success-only branch telemetry cannot distinguish a missing in-memory precondition from TryCastFriendlySpell rejection, so rerun138 does not support an unqualified behavioral explanation for the absent Stampeding Roar.

Unchanged canonical reconstruction reproduced 3868/4227 all-hostile retention, 309/4227 healer exposure, 7822 ms maximum dwell, 35 over-limit hostile episodes, and six causal waves concentrated in route generations 13 and 14.
Independent combat-attempt deduplication reproduced 222 Retribution attempts with 22 failures; every failure was Exorcism 879 rejected as spell_cast_result_53, which maps to SPELL_FAILED_MOVING.
The offensive executor stops cast-time movement and submits the cast in the same decision tick, proving that immediate submission does not reliably satisfy the spell system's stationary requirement.

The smallest evidence-supported next correction is diagnostic telemetry for every Stampeding Roar gate/rejection plus a one-tick stationary scheduling barrier for moving cast-time offensive spells; no route, threat, identity, party, role-quality, or acceptance gate changes are supported.
evidence_limitations: Rerun138 does not expose failed Stampeding Roar branch preconditions or TryCastFriendlySpell rejection reasons; no exact Feral blocker is claimed.
Live character_spell row count was verified before launch but is recorded as an execution-time database check rather than embedded into the immutable gameplay bundle.
Target entry attribution for Retribution failures uses stable runtime target IDs cross-referenced to route targets; the immutable failure cause itself does not depend on target attribution.
The next immutable canary remains authoritative for both the added Feral telemetry and the stationary scheduling correction.
